content.text:
I searched the knowledge store for this condition. There are 4 codes that, if recorded, would show that a person has eosinophilic oesophagitis:

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| J1017 | Eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| ^ESCTEO508265 | Eosinophilic esophagitis |
| ^ESCT1165474 | Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| ^ESCTEO508286 | Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus |

**A judgement call:** I included "Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus" because it is an eosinophilic oesophageal disease. If you want the strictest list, remove it.

**Left out on purpose:**
- **Codes that are too general:** oesophagitis NOS, non-reflux oesophagitis, and other specified oesophagitis.
- **Eosinophilic disease in other places or other forms:** eosinophilic gastritis, gastroenteritis, duodenitis, enteritis and colitis, plus hypereosinophilic syndrome and eosinophilia.
- **Other conditions that look similar:** reflux, erosive or ulcerative oesophagitis, allergic gastroenteritis, and food allergy.
- **Tests and findings:** eosinophil counts and oesophageal biopsy procedures.

I also searched for "EoE" and "primary eosinophilic oesophagitis". Neither search turned up any more codes.

content.text:
I found 4 codes in the knowledge store that point clearly to eosinophilic oesophagitis (EoE).

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| J1017 | Eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| ^ESCTEO508265 | Eosinophilic esophagitis |
| ^ESCT1165474 | Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| ^ESCTEO508286 | Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus |

The eosinophilic ulcer code is the only borderline choice. I included it because it describes eosinophilic disease of the oesophagus, but you could leave it out if you want a strict definition of EoE.

**Codes I left out on purpose:**
- **Eosinophilic disease elsewhere in the gut:** eosinophilic gastritis, gastroenteritis, duodenitis, enteritis and colitis. They affect other parts of the gut, not the oesophagus.
- **Oesophagitis without a stated cause:** oesophagitis, chronic oesophagitis, non-reflux oesophagitis, "Other specified oesophagitis" and "Oesophagitis NOS". These cover too many conditions to tell you someone has EoE.
- **Other eosinophil-related conditions:** eosinophilia, hypereosinophilic syndrome, "Eosinophilic disorder" and allergic eosinophilia. None of these is specific to the oesophagus.
- **Other allergic gut conditions:** allergic gastroenteritis or colitis and gastrointestinal food allergy. These are not oesophageal diagnoses.
- **Possible signs or complications:** oesophageal stricture, rings, food stuck in the oesophagus and difficulty swallowing. These can happen with EoE but don't confirm it.
- **Tests and procedures:** eosinophil counts and oesophageal biopsy codes.

content.text:
I searched the knowledge store and found four codes that indicate a person currently has eosinophilic oesophagitis.

**Codelist: Eosinophilic oesophagitis**

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| J1017 | Eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| ^ESCTEO508265 | Eosinophilic esophagitis |
| ^ESCT1165474 | Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis |
| ^ESCTEO508286 | Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus |

**Notes on what I included and left out:**
- **The ulcer code is a judgement call.** I included "Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus" because I believe SNOMED classes it as a type of eosinophilic oesophagitis, but I haven't checked that. Drop it if you want only the core diagnosis.
- **General oesophagitis codes are left out.** This covers codes like J101 Oesophagitis, J101y Other specified oesophagitis, J101z Oesophagitis NOS, Chronic oesophagitis and Non-reflux oesophagitis. They aren't specific enough to confirm this condition.
- **Other eosinophilic conditions are left out.** These are eosinophilic gastritis, enteritis, duodenitis, gastroenteritis and colitis, hypereosinophilic syndrome, and D403 Eosinophilic disorder. They affect other parts of the gut or are broader conditions.
- **Blood eosinophil codes are left out.** Eosinophil count results, eosinophilia and allergic eosinophilia are lab or general findings, not a diagnosis of this condition.
- **Symptoms and procedures are left out.** These include dysphagia, oesophageal stricture, oesophageal biopsy and endoscopy, because they don't confirm the diagnosis on their own.
